instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin at a slow pace and steadily accelerate your speech throughout the sentence, finishing at a very fast speed.
text: Круговорот воды в природе представляет собой сложный и непрерывный процесс, в ходе которого вода испаряется с поверхности океанов и суши, поднимается в атмосферу, конденсируется в облака и в конечном итоге возвращается на землю в виде осадков, питая реки и озёра.

target_values.speed: start slow, gradually accelerate to very fast

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic instruction, starting at a slow pace and steadily accelerating throughout the sentence to finish at a noticeably fast speed.

instruction_evidence.start_slow: The beginning of the sentence is spoken at a slow, deliberate pace.
instruction_evidence.steady_acceleration: The speed noticeably and continuously increases across the clauses.
instruction_evidence.finish_fast: The final clauses are delivered at a very fast speed, matching the instruction.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice has a slightly synthetic and robotic quality, especially noticeable during the faster sections.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is somewhat mechanical, focusing primarily on the speed change rather than rich expressive intonation.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this with a steady crescendo, beginning almost inaudibly and ending with a powerful, loud voice.

target_values.volume: begin very quiet and build up to very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to deliver the requested steady crescendo. It starts at a normal speaking volume rather than almost inaudibly, and the dynamic progression is largely flat, failing to reach a powerful, loud voice at the end.

instruction_evidence.beginning_volume: Starts at a normal conversational volume instead of being almost inaudible.
instruction_evidence.crescendo_and_ending: Lacks the requested steady build-up in volume; the ending only has a slight increase in intensity rather than a powerful, loud voice.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Not evaluated due to low instruction-following score.

text: Нет никаких сомнений в том, что это правильное решение для компании, оно принесет нам огромную прибыль... если, конечно, рынок отреагирует так, как мы предполагаем.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off loud, fast, and angry. Then, transition into a sad tone, slowing down and getting quieter. End the sentence in a slow, quiet, thoughtful manner.
text: Почему ты никогда меня не слушал, я же столько раз говорил тебе об этом, а теперь уже слишком поздно что-то менять, и остается только принять это.

target_values.emotion: start angry, then transition to sad, and end on a thoughtful note

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The requested dynamic progression is largely absent. The audio remains relatively flat in speed, volume, and emotion throughout the entire clip, failing to clearly demonstrate the loud/fast/angry start, the sad transition, or the slow/quiet/thoughtful ending.

instruction_evidence.start_loud_fast_angry: The beginning is spoken at a normal, moderate pace and volume, lacking true anger or high speed.
instruction_evidence.middle_transition_sad_slower_quieter: There is no significant decrease in volume or speed, and the emotion remains neutral rather than sad.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Switch back and forth between a pleading and a defiant tone as you read the different phrases in this sentence.

instruction_evidence.defiant_tone: The defiant sections ('но я никогда не соглашусь на это') lack any audible shift in power, intensity, or defiance.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Deliver this in three stages: first, speak normally; second, become very slow, low-pitched and quiet; third, suddenly become very fast, high-pitched and loud.
text: Я шел по темному коридору, и вдруг в самом конце я увидел, как под дверью медленно пробивается тонкий лучик света... и внезапно дверь распахнулась!

target_values.speed: normal, then very slow, then suddenly very fast
target_values.volume: normal, then very quiet, then suddenly very loud

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The dynamic progression is flattened and weak. The second stage fails to become significantly slow, low-pitched, or quiet. The third stage shows some increase in pitch and speed, but lacks the strong contrast requested.

instruction_evidence.stage_1: The first part is delivered normally.
instruction_evidence.stage_2: The middle section is supposed to be very slow, low-pitched, and quiet, but the delivery remains quite similar to the first stage with only very subtle changes.
instruction_evidence.stage_3: The final phrase is faster and higher-pitched, but the volume is not very loud and the overall contrast is weak.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin speaking in a happy and playful tone, but about halfway through, shift to a sad and disappointed tone.
text: О, я выиграл билеты на концерт, как здорово, мы так давно хотели пойти... ой, подожди, это же на прошлую неделю.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully shifts from an excited, happy tone in the first half to a slower, lower-pitched, disappointed tone in the second half, clearly realizing the dynamic instruction.

instruction_evidence.happy_and_playful_start: The first half is delivered with a very fast pace and high pitch, conveying excitement and happiness.
instruction_evidence.sad_and_disappointed_end: Starting at 'ой, подожди', the pacing slows significantly and the pitch drops, audibly conveying realization and disappointment.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech in the first half is noticeably rushed and has a slightly synthesized, choppy cadence.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional contrast and dynamic progression between the two halves are strongly distinct and well-acted.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Start off by giving the instructions quickly and with an urging tone, then slow down and shift into a complaining tone as you finish.
text: Так, быстро бери эти коробки, неси их на склад и раскладывай по полкам... господи, почему этим всегда приходится заниматься именно мне.

target_values.speed: start fast and then become slow
target_values.tone: begin with an urging tone, but then shift to a complaining one

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly realizes the requested dynamic progression. It starts fast and urging during the first half, and then noticeably slows down while shifting to a convincing complaining tone for the second half.

instruction_evidence.speed_change: The speaker starts with a rapid pace and significantly slows down after the ellipsis.
instruction_evidence.tone_shift: The first part sounds demanding and urgent, while the second part shifts to a weary, complaining delivery.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice is smooth and human-like with no noticeable synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional transition is well-executed, with the complaining part sounding particularly genuine and expressive.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Recount this story in a surprised and excited tone, letting your volume and pitch fluctuate throughout, getting louder and higher on the most unbelievable parts.
text: Ты не поверишь, я иду по улице, и вдруг вижу огромную толпу, а в центре стоит слон, представляешь, настоящий живой слон!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker successfully recounts the story with a surprised and excited tone, dynamically increasing both pitch and volume towards the end as the narrative reaches its unbelievable climax.

instruction_evidence.emotion: A surprised and excited tone is clearly maintained and escalating throughout the recording.
instruction_evidence.dynamic_progression: Pitch and volume fluctuate and steadily increase, reaching their peak on the most unbelievable part ('настоящий живой слон!').

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds completely natural, with smooth transitions and authentic human-like intonation.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly expressive, perfectly capturing the escalating excitement and astonishment of the story.

instruction: Speak in Russian. Begin your speech with a loud, high-pitched, and happy voice. Gradually let your voice become quieter, lower in pitch, and emotionally neutral as if you are running out of steam.
text: Лучший день в моей жизни! Утром мне сделали предложение! Я так счастлива, я кричала от радости! Мы весь день праздновали, гуляли по городу, ели в ресторане. Было просто волшебно. А сейчас уже поздно, я очень устала. Нужно смыть макияж, переодеться и просто лечь. Завтра будет много дел.

target_values.emotion: start happy, but gradually fade to neutral
target_values.volume: start loud and gradually fade to very quiet
target_values.pitch: start high and gradually fall to low

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly follows the dynamic instruction, starting loud, high-pitched, and happy, and effectively transitioning to a quieter, lower-pitched, and neutral delivery by the end.

instruction_evidence.start_stage: The beginning of the audio is delivered with a loud volume, high pitch, and a noticeably happy and excited emotion.
instruction_evidence.progression_and_end_stage: As the speech progresses, the volume and pitch gradually decrease, culminating in a quiet, low-pitched, and neutral/tired tone at the end.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds human-like, and the transition between states is smooth without sounding artificial.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The emotional shift from exuberance to exhaustion is rich, believable, and clearly shaped.
